title: Interpreting graph neural networks reveals microbial association patterns in inflammatory bowel diseases
summary: Interpretable GNNs applied to individual-specific microbial association networks identify an IBD-associated co-abundance structure that is not captured by abundance-only feature ranking. The GNN underperformed random forest predictively; the result is structural interpretation, not a superior diagnostic model.
